Security evidence addendum: PR #149 at fb87062f7ebcb6f850279923ecb683833dffa45f
Existing BLOCK remains unchanged; S005 is now explicitly included.
This is historical-head evidence, not a verdict on replacement697b6aa.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 1 | 🟠 HIGH | crates/daemon/src/delivery/role_send.rs | 1365-1368 | Unquoted stored holder ID injects shell syntax into state guidance | 9/10 |

Explicit spawn IDs reject only blank values (http/mod.rs:1226-1229). Core admission.rs:122-147 checks ordinary harness/folder/binding conditions, not shell-safe ID grammar. Registry persistence and assignment preserve the ID; the holders schema requires only a string.

Role resolution copies the ID into request.holder (:308-312); time_limit_step reconstructs it (:1094), then the unanswered notice prints pij state with the holder unquoted. A benign demonstration ID such as pij-demo$(printf DEMO) passes those ID checks when ordinary admission conditions hold. Following the recommendation invokes command substitution before pij receives the argument; receiving the notice alone executes nothing.

Render the complete state command through picture::command, as the adjacent release already does. Add a generated-notice /bin/sh exact-word/no-file regression; the current hostile-instance regression does not cover this stored-holder sink.

S005 is an inherited sink brought into scope by pm-001, not a newly introduced fb change. Original targeted S001/S002 fixes remain source-closed; S003/S004 authority findings remain in the existing BLOCK.

No payloads, shells, tmux, tests or builds were executed. No code or credentials were changed/read. The amended PR comment was NOT posted: its exact-head gate detected the replacement697b6aa push while publication was being prepared.
